meta.purpose: A heterogeneous, multi-relational knowledge graph for Spatial Graph projections and Spatial Canvas detail views.
meta.model: One continuous multiplex semantic mesh. Projects, capabilities, actors, flows, decisions, AI practices, evidence, and time coexist as relation layers. Camera profiles change emphasis and spatial force, never the underlying graph.
principles: Metrics and ownership claims must preserve evidence status.
Prototype routes are evidence, not first-level portfolio nodes.
AI assists activities inside projects and workflows; it is not rendered as a disconnected content branch.
Human judgment owns decisions and verification.
Shared facets describe content; camera profiles change how the same continuous mesh is viewed without replacing its topology.

home.behavior: Hover or focus reveals one-hop relations. Selecting a project opens its local canvas. AI enablement appears contextually inside related themes, methods, and work rather than as an independent homepage node.
home.metricPolicy: Metrics are hidden from the initial graph and appear only inside the relevant local view with evidence status.

aiEnablement.behavior: Reveal the relevant AI practice beside the product theme, method, experience, or evidence it enables. Do not render a disconnected AI island.

projectTemplate.interaction: Start from a project and its activities. Let each activity connect outward to domains, AI modes, artifacts, and related project internals. Do not force a single reading direction.

knowledgeGraph.identityPolicy: A node keeps one stable ID and one factual neighborhood. Camera-specific position and emphasis must never be stored as node truth.
knowledgeGraph.layoutPolicy: There is no universal X/Y/Z and no separate graph per camera. Screen position is a temporary result of weighted semantic forces applied to the same mesh.
knowledgeGraph.focusPolicy: Selecting any node traverses both incoming and outgoing edges according to edgeTypes[type].traversal. Direction remains visible for causal, temporal, evidence, and value-flow relations.
knowledgeGraph.continuityPolicy: Camera changes preserve the focused node, all directly connected relation layers, and a quiet one-hop context. They may reweight or dim relations but must not replace the graph.

evolution.label: 理解演化
evolution.purpose: Connect chronology, reuse, reflection, and capability growth without inventing causality.

mesh.continuity: All nodes and factual edges belong to one connected semantic space. Relation layers may be emphasized, dimmed, or temporarily collapsed, but they are not rebuilt as separate graphs.

semanticFields.projectGravity: Pulls project-local actors, objects, systems, decisions, journeys, and evidence toward their project context.
semanticFields.capabilityGravity: Pulls shared activities and projects toward the themes they demonstrate.
semanticFields.workflowGravity: Orders activities and state transitions by lifecycle or process sequence.
semanticFields.boundaryGravity: Separates actors, ownership, external systems, and handoff zones.
semanticFields.evidenceGravity: Pulls claims toward artifacts, metrics, sources, and verification status.
semanticFields.temporalGravity: Orders dated nodes without turning chronology into causality.
semanticFields.enablementGravity: Connects AI assistance, human activity, output, team transfer, and reusable assets.

positioning.sourceOfTruth: semantic fields, typed edges, facets, focus, and the active camera profile
positioning.storagePolicy: Do not store one permanent x/y/z coordinate as content truth.
positioning.transitionPolicy: Animate nodes between camera-weighted positions while preserving identity, neighborhood continuity, and relation direction.

cameraProfileSemantics.anchorNodeTypes: Preferred entry types and gravitational anchors, not the only visible types.
cameraProfileSemantics.anchorNodes: Suggested starting nodes; focus may begin at any connected node.
cameraProfileSemantics.emphasizeNodeTypes: Types receiving full visual weight; one-hop context remains visible when relevant.
cameraProfileSemantics.emphasizeEdgeTypes: Relations receiving stronger force and opacity; other direct relations remain available.
cameraProfileSemantics.spatialBias: A temporary arrangement bias applied to the same mesh.
cameraProfileSemantics.semanticForces: Camera-specific force meanings; not permanent coordinates.
cameraProfileSemantics.guidedPath: Optional reading order through the continuous mesh.
